name: 25 more employers — full public boards
description: Twenty-five additional companies absent from the catalog and freshly screened against FreeHire. These recipes traverse the entire named employer-specific public Jobillico boards, including every pagination page and advertised career-opportunity item. English/French posting IDs were compared. All observed postings have full source descriptions. No title, country, role-count, page-count or description-count cap is authored. Completeness describes the named public boards, not an assertion that every worldwide vacancy is advertised on that provider.
